# Client protocol reference

Protocol `1.0`: JSON-RPC 2.0 over the daemon's loopback WebSocket, one message per text frame. The [client protocol guide](../guide/client-protocol.md) explains attaching, the handshake, events and server requests; this page lists every name of `schema/rpc.json`. A name whose contract is "not served yet" is reserved for its owning capability and answered `-32006 rpc.not_served` until that capability lands.

## Types

### `Ack`

`{"ok": true}`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ok` | boolean | yes | Always true. |

### `AdapterStatePayload`

`adapter.state` payload: one messaging adapter changed state (spec: platform-adapters, Adapter state reporting and reconnect).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attention` | boolean | no | Outside `connected` longer than `gateway.reconnect_attention_secs` (set once per outage, cleared on reconnect). |
| `code` | string or null | no | Error code of a `degraded`, `retrying` or `fatal` adapter. |
| `message` | string or null | no | What happened. |
| `platform` | string | yes | Platform name. |
| `profile` | string | yes | The owning profile. |
| `state` | string | yes | `disabled`, `connecting`, `connected`, `degraded`, `retrying` or `fatal`. |

### `Admission`

How `prompt.submit` admitted an input (spec: tui, Prompt submission while busy).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `started` | Its turn started. |
| `queued` | A turn was running: it runs after the queued inputs before it (`busy.input_mode = "queue"`, or `interrupt`, which stops the running turn first). |
| `steered` | Handed to the running turn after its current tool step (`busy.input_mode = "steer"`). |

### `ApprovalAnswer`

The answer to `approval.request` (also `approval.respond` params, with its `id`).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `accepted_hunks` | array of integer or null | no | For a diff approval: the hunks accepted. |
| `decision` | [`Decision`](#decision) | yes | The decision. |
| `replacement` | string or null | no | An edited command to run instead. |

### `ApprovalFinding`

Why a call needs approval.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `detector` | string | yes | The detector (`dangerous-pattern`, `protected-file`, ...). |
| `fragment` | string | yes | The offending part, invisible characters escaped. |
| `reason` | string | yes | What it found. |

### `ApprovalRequestParams`

`approval.request` params.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `call_id` | string | yes | The model's call id. |
| `deadline_ms` | integer or null | no | Milliseconds until the request settles unanswered (set by the daemon when it sends the request). |
| `explanation` | string or null | no | What an `explain` answer produced: the parsed command, the rule, the paths it touches and a dry-run preview (the request is asked again with it). |
| `findings` | array of [`ApprovalFinding`](#approvalfinding) | yes | Why approval is needed. |
| `remember` | string or null | no | What `session` and `always` record. |
| `session_id` | string | yes | The session. |
| `subject` | string or null | no | The command line or written path. |
| `tool` | string | yes | The tool called. |

### `ApprovalRespondParams`

`approval.respond` params.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `accepted_hunks` | array of integer or null | no | For a diff approval: the hunks accepted. |
| `decision` | [`Decision`](#decision) | yes | The decision. |
| `id` | string | yes | The `approval.request` id (`srq-<12 hex>`). |
| `replacement` | string or null | no | An edited command to run instead. |

### `AttachParams`

`session.attach` params.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `epoch` | string or null | no | The daemon epoch `last_seen_seq` belongs to; another epoch than the daemon's answers `truncated: true` and replays nothing. |
| `last_seen_seq` | integer or null | no | The newest sequence number the client applied: the kept events after it are replayed before the answer. |
| `role` | [`AttachRole`](#attachrole) | no | Driver (default) or observer. |
| `session_id` | string | yes | `ses_<ULID>`. |

### `AttachRole`

What an attached connection may do in the session.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `driver` | Submits, interrupts and answers the session's requests. |
| `observer` | Reads only: receives events, never server requests, and may not submit (`-32002 session.observer`). |

### `Attached`

`session.attach` / `session.resume` result.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `epoch` | string | yes | The daemon epoch the sequence numbers belong to. |
| `latest_seq` | integer | yes | The newest event sequence number kept for it. |
| `open_requests` | array of [`OpenRequest`](#openrequest) | no | Requests of the session still waiting for an answer (re-sent to this connection when it is a capable driver). |
| `session_id` | string | yes | The session. |
| `truncated` | boolean | no | Events after the client's `last_seen_seq` were evicted, or the client's epoch is not this daemon's: reload the transcript (`session.transcript`) instead of applying the replayed events. |

### `BannerInfo`

`session.banner` result: what the TUI's startup banner lists.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `degraded` | string or null | no | The degraded marker while the session runs below full hardening, for example `sandbox: partial:landlock_net` (spec: security-boundaries, Hardening downgrades are never silent). |
| `mcp_servers` | array of [`McpServerState`](#mcpserverstate) | yes | The session's MCP servers. |
| `skills` | array of string | yes | The installed skills the session can load. |
| `system_prompt` | [`FrozenPrompt`](#frozenprompt) or null | no | The frozen system prompt; none before the first turn. |
| `tools` | array of string | yes | The session's tool names, in request order. |

### `ClarifyAnswers`

`clarify.request` result.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `answers` | array of any | yes | One answer per question, as the `clarify` tool defines them. |

### `ClarifyRequestParams`

`clarify.request` params.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `allow_other` | boolean | yes | Surfaces render a free-text `Other` option. |
| `deadline_ms` | integer or null | no | Milliseconds until the request settles unanswered (set by the daemon when it sends the request). |
| `questions` | array of any | yes | The questions, as the `clarify` tool defines them. |
| `session_id` | string | yes | The session. |

### `ClientCapabilities`

What the client can handle.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `events` | array of string | no | Events introduced after the client's minor version that it understands anyway. |
| `server_requests` | boolean | no | The client answers server-to-client requests (approvals, clarify, secrets, sudo). Without it they resolve unanswered at once. |

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `cli` | `prometheus chat` attached to the daemon. |
| `tui` | `prometheus tui`. |
| `desktop` | The desktop app. |
| `dashboard` | The web dashboard. |

### `CommandCatalog`

### `CommandEntry`

One `commands.catalog` entry.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `disposition` | [`Disposition`](#disposition) | yes | Whether it runs from the asking client's surface. |
| `name` | string | yes | The name without `/`. |

Where a command comes from.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|

| `quick` | A `[quick_commands]` entry. |
| `skill` | An installed skill. |
| `client` | Handled by the client itself (never dispatched). |

`session.context_usage` result.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |

### `Decision`

An approval answer.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `once` | Allow this call. |
| `session` | Allow matching calls for the rest of the session. |
| `always` | Allow matching calls from now on (recorded in `grants.toml`). |
| `deny` | Refuse. |
| `explain` | Show the parsed command, the rule, the paths it touches and a dry-run preview, then ask again; never an approval. |

### `DispatchParams`

`command.dispatch` params: a slash command the client does not handle itself (spec: tui, Slash command flow).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `args` | string | no | The rest of the line, case kept. |
| `name` | string | yes | The command name without `/` (an alias or unique prefix resolves). |
| `session_id` | string | yes | The session. |

### `Dispatched`

`command.dispatch` result.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `` | The command ran; `notice` is its output to show. |
| `` | Submit `message` as a prompt (with `images`). |
| `` | The command did not run. |

### `Disposition`

Where a command runs from this surface.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `exec` | It runs (`command.dispatch`). |
| `unavailable` | Listed, but refused here with `reason`. |
| `hidden` | Not offered on this surface. |

### `EgressSetParams`

`egress.set` params: changes applied in order (mode, then allow, then deny); an empty change only reads the policy.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `allow` | array of string | no | Host patterns to admit (`host`, `host:port`, `*.suffix`). |
| `deny` | array of string | no | Host patterns to refuse in every mode. |
| `mode` | string or null | no | `public`, `allowlist` or `none`. |
| `session_id` | string | yes | The session. |

### `EgressState`

`egress.set` result: the session's policy after the change.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `allow` | array of string | yes | Admitted patterns. |
| `deny` | array of string | yes | Refused patterns. |
| `mode` | string | yes | The mode. |

### `Empty`

No params.


### `Envelope`

One event frame: the notification params and the replay item.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | any | yes | The payload, as the event's contract defines it. |
| `epoch` | string | yes | The daemon epoch. |
| `event` | string | yes | The event name. |
| `seq` | integer | yes | Per-session monotonic sequence number (per daemon for daemon-wide events). |
| `session_id` | string or null | no | The session it belongs to; `None` for daemon-wide events. |

### `EventsSince`

`session.events.since` result.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `epoch` | string | yes | The daemon epoch; a different one than the client's means the daemon restarted and the client resets its watermark. |
| `events` | array of [`Envelope`](#envelope) | yes | The kept events after `last_seen`, oldest first. |
| `latest_seq` | integer | yes | The newest sequence number of the session. |
| `open_requests` | array of [`OpenRequest`](#openrequest) | yes | Requests of the session still waiting for an answer. |
| `truncated` | boolean | yes | Events after `last_seen` were evicted. |

### `EventsSinceParams`

`session.events.since` params.

### `SessionSetup`

How a daemon session runs: the session-shaping flags of `prometheus chat`, applied when the session loads (spec: cli, Daemon attachment with in-process fallback).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `api_key` | string or null | no | That endpoint's API key (`--api-key-stdin`), held in memory only. |
| `base_url` | string or null | no | An endpoint for this session only (`--base-url`). |
| `ignore_rules` | boolean | no | No rule files, identity file, memory snapshot or preloaded skills (`--ignore-rules`). |
| `ignore_user_config` | boolean | no | Schema defaults instead of the profile's `config.toml` (`--ignore-user-config`). |
| `mock_script` | string or null | no | A mock provider script on the daemon's machine (`--mock-script`). |
| `model` | string or null | no | The model (`[<provider>/]<model>` or an alias) instead of the profile's (`-m`). |
| `no_context_files` | boolean | no | No `AGENTS.md`-style context files (`--no-context-files`). |
| `pass_session_id` | boolean | no | The system prompt names the session id (`--pass-session-id`). |
| `provider` | string or null | no | The provider instead of the profile's (`--provider`). |
| `set` | array of string | no | `key=value` configuration overrides for this session only (`--set`, `--approvals`, `--max-iterations`, `--toolsets`). |
| `skills` | array of string | no | Skills preloaded into the session (`--skills`). |
| `yolo` | boolean | no | Approval-gated calls run without asking (`--yolo`). |
